findings.title: P0: updating a non-first bitfield changes the wrong bits

reproduction.layout: struct root { uint8 low:4; uint8 high:4; };

findings.title: P0: parsed unions are not safely round-trippable

reproduction.layout: union choice { uint8 small; uint16 large; };

findings.title: P1: indexed fixed-array updates invoke the whole-array writer

reproduction.observedBeforeFix: InvalidOperationException: Expected an array or list

findings.title: P1: final targets of multi-level pointer updates use the wrong codec

reproduction.operation: UpdateStream root.ptr.value.value to 0x1234 with one-byte pointers
reproduction.observedBeforeFix: The final primitive was rejected as an oversized pointer address

findings.title: P1: pointers to unions are read as sequential structs

reproduction.layout: union choice { uint8 small; uint16 large; }; struct root { choice *target; };
reproduction.expected: small=0x34 and large=0x1234 from the same target address
reproduction.observedBeforeFix: CStructReadException: Not enough bytes in stream

findings.title: P1: wide terminated strings ignore layout endianness

reproduction.layout: struct root { wchar value[]; }; with big-endian layout

findings.title: P1: accepted enum storage types cannot preserve their value domain

reproduction.layout: enum state : uint32 { Known = 1 }; struct root { state value; };

findings.acceptedDecision: Implement exact width- and signedness-aware enum values with one BigInteger public projection and no Int32 compatibility bridge.

findings.title: P1: duplicate field names compile into an ambiguous layout

reproduction.layout: struct root { uint8 value; uint16 value; };
reproduction.operation: Construct CStruct before any stream operation
reproduction.observedBeforeFix: Layout accepted; parse and path resolution selected different declarations

findings.title: P2: inline struct names are incorrectly global

reproduction.layout: struct first { struct { uint8 small; } value; }; struct second { struct { uint16 large; } value; };
reproduction.operation: Construct one CStruct and parse both roots
reproduction.expected: Both unrelated lexical value fields compile and retain independent shapes
